tasks.title: Essay: School data policy priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
In your English class you have been discussing how schools should manage students' online data. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most important thing for a school to do when planning its data policy?

Notes

Write about:

1. protecting students' personal information
2. teaching students about online privacy
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Review: School data privacy workshop
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement in your school's English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted!

Have you attended a workshop about online privacy at your school? We want to hear about your experience. Write a review of the workshop for our magazine.

Describe what the workshop covered, say how useful it was for understanding data protection, and explain whether you would recommend it to other students.

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Article: Encouraging responsible data habits
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a youth website.

Articles wanted!

How can students protect their own online data at school?

Write an article for our website suggesting one practical habit students can adopt, explaining why it is effective, and describing what the benefit would be for their long-term privacy.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Email: Explaining school data policy
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Chris.

From: Chris
Subject: Your school's data policy

Hi,
I heard your school has introduced a new data policy about how students' online information is used. I'm curious about it. Can you tell me what the policy says? Do you think it's fair? Also, what's one thing you think could be improved?

Thanks!
Chris

Write your email.
